There are several ways to sort a list in Python. Here are the most common methods:

## 1. Using `sort()` method (in-place sorting)

This modifies the original list and returns `None`:

```python
numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
numbers.sort()
print(numbers)  # [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]
```

## 2. Using `sorted()` function (returns new list)

This creates a new sorted list and leaves the original unchanged:

```python
numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)
print(numbers)  # [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90] (unchanged)
print(sorted_numbers)  # [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]
